summary.text: Dianne Hesselbein is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 27 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 79, from 2013 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Dianne Hesselbein was born in Wisconsin and lives in Middleton.
She graduated from La Follette High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Oshkosh and a master's degree in religious studies from Edgewood College.
Hesselbein was elected to the Middleton-Cross Plains School District board of education in 2005 and to the Dane County board of supervisors in 2008.
She has also volunteered with the VFW Women's Auxiliary, the Girl Scouts of America, and as a friend of the Pheasant Branch Conservancy.
In the 2025-2026 session, Hesselbein was assigned to the Legislative Organization, Joint Legislative Council, Employment Relations and Senate Organization committees.
